digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler pause/resume and gate format
propositions: Pause/resume surface must preserve dual-format remote blob with gated_mode reconcile-check plus paused metadata fields and enforce git-email provenance and first-pause RFC3339 timestamp
Pause blocks before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker; scheduled workflow recognizes only that marker and skips commit-and-push

Resume performs observed-OID CAS and safely repairs corrupt or absent state without decoding; same-reason pause is idempotent and metadata-stable while different-reason and missing-identity cases refuse without overwrite
Legacy reconcile-check early return, old rebar reconcile --mode vocabulary, and pre-change gate rc 4 behavior remain functional with no rename or removal
Corrupt blobs return clean rc 1 recovery line without traceback; malformed or unanchored markers and ordinary success retain existing behavior
CLI help, generated reference, user guide, and exit-code docs expose preview/sync/pause/resume commands with no automatic expiry or until flag
